ModuleName: Creating a Course: The Course Manager and Source Materials

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: Lists and organises all topics covered in this module — including the Course Manager interface, creating new courses, AI-generated course creation, accepted source material types, and primary vs. secondary sources — giving learners and instructors an at-a-glance roadmap of the module's content.

Artifacts.Name: Introduction to the Course Manager
Artifacts.Description: Explains what the Course Manager is, why it serves as the central hub of PreseMaker, and how learners navigate its interface, providing the foundational orientation needed before attempting any course-creation task.

Artifacts.Name: Creating a New Course
Artifacts.Description: Walks learners step by step through the process of starting a new course in PreseMaker's Course Manager, covering how to open the tool, initiate course creation, and choose between building an empty course or using AI generation.

Artifacts.Name: AI-Generated Course Creation
Artifacts.Description: Describes PreseMaker's AI-generated course creation feature, explaining how it works, when to use it over manual building, and how it compresses the time and expertise required to produce a structured course from source material.

Artifacts.Name: Accepted Source Material Types
Artifacts.Description: Identifies and explains the different file and content types that PreseMaker accepts as source material — such as slide decks and documents — helping learners understand what inputs they can bring to the course-building process.

Artifacts.Name: Primary vs. Secondary Sources
Artifacts.Description: Explains the distinction PreseMaker makes between primary and secondary source materials, describing how each designation affects what the AI generates, so learners can make informed decisions when setting up their source materials.
